candidates.sentence: In Congress, I will make border security a top priority by allocating resources to target and end illegal border crossings and crimes at the border.
I will work with President Trump to build the wall and will work to pass a bill classifying drug cartels as the terrorist organizations they are.
I will always vote to defend our border and protect private property.
Abe will always fight for the rights of the unborn, especially against any effort that allows abortion with little to no restrictions.

He now has an opportunity to take the entrenched political class head on and change the system by supporting America first principles that will secure our southern border and stand up for everyday Arizonans getting crushed by the Biden economy.
Border Security is National Security and I’m proud to have the support of President Trump's National Security Team.
At a time when Americans are hurting and seeing the value of their dollar devalued, we must do everything we can to preserve Social Security for our seniors.
